Creatify vs VEXI: AI Video Ads or Your Whole Social Media?
Creatify and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Creatify is built to make, launch and test ads [1]. Here is how it compares with one app that runs your everyday social media.

Creatify is an AI ad maker [1]. Give it a product link or your product's images, videos and details, and it builds video and image ads, with ready-made AI actors and custom avatars [1][2]. It can push finished ads to the platforms where you advertise, such as Meta, Google and TikTok [1]. Its pricing page lists Standard at $10 a month billed yearly with 55 credits a month, up to Business from $136 a month billed yearly, and a no-cost tier of 10 credits a month with watermarked exports [2]. Unused credits roll over for one extra month, then expire [2].

VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is the job each is built for. Creatify is built for ads: it researches, creates, launches and optimizes them [1]. Your everyday feed needs posts, carousels, edited clips of you and your work, captions and a steady rhythm every week. VEXI does that job: you ask, it makes it, and Autopilot posts it. VEXI costs more than Creatify: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Creatify turns a product, app or service into ready-to-launch ads, keeps them on brand with your logo, colors and fonts, and pushes them to ad platforms such as Meta, Google and TikTok [1].
VEXI schedules and posts to your connected accounts itself.
Creatify's AI video editor takes a clip you upload, cuts pauses and filler words, adds captions, titles and music, and resizes it for each feed [3].
